fixed.problem: L4h-left-1 (never cut): in chat every note reaches a task command through the model's call, so L4f's rule (a note is the person's only on their own command) made every chat note the model's. 'Try the digest page again and tell it to use the old layout' was read back to the person as if the model wrote it ('Note for its next brief: ...'), the Yes said 'The note goes into its next brief.', and the note was queued as the agent's. Session lead decision 2026-11-24: a note is the person's when its words are in the person's own message; a note the model wrote without them is read back.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/commands/test/chat-final.test.ts 'a move with the person's own words as its note: no note in the read-back, 'Your note' after the yes, queued as the person's, and its reason is the person's words' and 'a failed task's card: the person's own words answer its Try again with the note, read back without it; after a restart the yes still answers it so' (3 of the file's 5 cases failed at base); packages/runtime/test/chat-fix-tasks.test.ts 'the person's words passed as the note: the read-back names none, the yes after a restart says 'Your note', and the note is queued as theirs' (composed, two composes on one store); apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts 'l4-chat-final, run L4' > 'L4h-left-1: POST /chat: the person's own words as a pause's note are not read back, the Yes says 'Your note' and the note is theirs; a note the model made up is read back, 'The note' and the agent's' and 'L4h-left-1: POST /chat: the person's own words to try a failed task again answer its card's Try again with their note, which is not read back to them, and reach the next brief' (both failed at base)
fixed.how: New notesPersons(ctx, note) and saidInLine(line, note) in packages/commands/src/commands/shared.ts. A note is the person's when the actor is the person on their own command, or when the turn is chat or voice and the note's words appear together and in order in the person's own line (ctx.wordsUsed, which the stored card context keeps across a restart). The words must not come within 4 words after a turning word of the same clause, such as don't, without or nicht. task.ts's noteClause, noteGoes, queued-note author and notedByAgent all use it, and request.ts's ask read-back does too. moveAsCardAnswer (task.ts) answers a redirected move with the card's note-taking option and the person's note (not read back). On an option that takes no note, the person's note keeps the move so their words are kept, except on a high-risk card. The bench stand-in gains FORERUNNER_BENCH_CHAT_NOTE, which makes the chat model add a note it made up. A note written in a 'tool:' line is in the person's line.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Bench (--provider bench): make a project with a ready task 'Write the FAQ', open its Chat and send: tool: task_pause {"task": "Write the FAQ", "note": "Wait for the logo."}. The read-back reads 'Pause "Write the FAQ"? No session runs it until you press Resume.' with no 'Note for its next brief' clause. Press Yes: 'Paused "Write the FAQ": no session runs it until you press Resume. Your note goes into its next brief.' Then start the bench with FORERUNNER_BENCH_CHAT_NOTE='Put on hold by the person.' and send tool: task_pause {"task": "Write the FAQ"}. The read-back ends 'Note for its next brief: "Put on hold by the person."' and the Yes says 'The note goes into its next brief.' live_check (real model, owner): (1) in a project's chat type 'Pause Write the FAQ and note: wait for the logo.' Expect no note clause in the read-back; after Yes, 'Your note goes into its next brief.', and the task drawer's queued note is yours. (2) With a failed task's card open, type 'Try the digest page again and tell it to use the old layout.' The card is answered Try again, the read-back does not repeat the note, and the next session's brief carries 'use the old layout'. (3) Type 'Pause Write the FAQ' with no note. If the model adds a note of its own, the read-back names it and the Yes says 'The note ...'.

fixed.how: givenReason(ctx, ...texts) in task.ts: in a chat or voice turn, only the person's own words (notesPersons) stand as a reason. Otherwise the command's own default reason is kept (transition, dependencies, update edit reason, 'Redo asked by you').

On Changes (and in the task drawer's reason line), the reason is not 'Put on hold by the person.'. live_check: ask the chat to raise a task's priority without giving a reason; the change's reason is the app's own, never words the model made up.

fixed.problem: L4h-left-5 (review of l4-chat-carried C4-left-7): (1) a second sync in the same process that read a suggestion card as 'applying' while the first sync was applying it took the card for a crash's leftover and settled it again, so a set the first sync could not make was tried twice. (2) A card a crash left at 'applying' after its change was made was settled without naming the changes the apply left out, and admitted no tasks it touched.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/task-proposal-sync.test.ts 'a second sync that read the card as 'applying' while the first applied it does not apply it again' and 'a card a crash left at 'applying' after its change was made names the change the apply left out and admits the task it changed'
fixed.how: settleProposal (packages/runtime/src/session/task-proposal.ts) now marks the card with a compare-and-set on its version (store.humanRequest.update). On version_conflict it returns 'skipped' and the sync does not count it. The recovered path computes left_out with the commands' own check (deps.check), admits the touched tasks as well as the made ones, and records waits_for_you.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Bench: let the agent file a suggestion card ('The agent suggests changes'), press 'Make these changes' in the Inbox, and read the Answered line. It names each change that was left out, with why. live_check: press 'Make these changes' and stop the app at once. After a restart, the card's Answered line names what was left out, and the changed tasks run at the next Start, with no change applied twice.

fixed.problem: L4h-left-5 sibling: a merged-through card's 'Take this work out' is marked taken_out before the take-out runs. A crash between that mark and the take-out's answer left the card at 'Taking the work out: the answer comes in a moment.' for good, because no later sync looked at it again.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/pr-answers-takeout.test.ts 'the next sync asks the take-out again and the Answered line says what came of it; a later sync asks nothing'
fixed.how: A new finishTakeOuts(deps) runs first in syncPrAnswers (packages/runtime/src/session/pr-answers.ts). For answered, left-open decision rows with outcome taken_out, applied_at set and no take_out_result, it asks TaskTakeOut.takeOut again. That call is idempotent on the task's merge record: an open pull request reads 'is being taken out in #N' and a merged one 'was taken out in #N'. It patches take_out_result into the Answered line. A take-out this process is running now is left alone (takingOutNow).
fixed.check_in_the_app: Bench with the GitHub stand-in: on a merged-through card press 'Take this work out' and stop the app before the answer comes. After a restart, the card's Answered line says what came of it ('... is being taken out in #N'), not 'Taking the work out: the answer comes in a moment.'. live_check (owner, real GitHub sandbox): the same with a real pull request. Exactly one take-out pull request is opened.

A set whose split was left out and whose drop applied still said 'your next Start runs it', and it said so even when what changed waits for a task only the person can do, which no Start runs.

notes_for_other_areas: notesPersons(ctx, note) and saidInLine(line, note) in packages/commands/src/commands/shared.ts are the one test of whose words a note is (the person's when its words are together and in order in ctx.wordsUsed of a chat or voice turn, and not within 4 words after a turning word of the clause). Any command that reads back or attributes a note or reason should use it rather than ctx.actor alone.
givenReason(ctx, ...texts) in packages/commands/src/commands/task.ts: in chat or voice, only the person's own words become a task's reason. Use it for any new command that stores a reason.

moveAsCardAnswer (task.ts) carries the note for a note-taking option or a high-risk card. The executor's cardTitleOf now returns {title, takesNote}, and the answer_on_card refusal ends 'Nothing else was filed; type your note there with <option>.' or 'Nothing else was filed, and your note was not kept.'

task_proposal sync: settleProposal returns 'applied' | 'kept' | 'failed' | 'skipped'. 'skipped' means another sync won the compare-and-set and is not counted. The card's change_card gains waits_for_you (the title of the person's task the changed tasks wait for), which proposalOutcome words as 'it waits for "X", which is yours to do.'

pr-answers.ts: finishTakeOuts(deps) runs first in syncPrAnswers and the takingOutNow set guards in-process take-outs. l4-github-carried or any later take-out change should keep both (take_out_result is the patched Answered line).

Bench stand-in: FORERUNNER_BENCH_CHAT_NOTE='<words>' makes the chat model add a note it made up to a tool call that takes a note (documented in scripts/bench/README.md). A note in a 'tool:' line is the person's own.
conversation/claims.ts aboutNow(rest): absences about sessions or changes are history (recall first) unless they carry a word of now. Tasks, cards and questions are unchanged.
parserQuestionReply joins options with '; ' when any option holds a comma.
